method.method_draft: Scan the image from left to right and tally only bonds between non-hydrogen atoms. Count the Ar-C bond, the C=C bond, the C-O+ bond, the O-C bond, the C-C bond to the left carbonyl, the left C=O bond, the C-C bond from that carbonyl to the central carbon, the central C-Ru bond, the central C-C bond to the right carbonyl, the right C=O bond, and the C-O bond to OR1. Do not count the central C-H bond or any curved arrows. The tally gives 11.
